name: Aurora Table Lamp
description: A dimmable oak lamp with a linen shade that throws a soft, low glow. Reads as expensive without shouting about it.

name: Halden Floor Lamp
description: An arc floor lamp that leans over an armchair. Sturdy base, no wobble.

name: Ember Ceramic Candle
description: Cedar, black pepper and a little smoke. Burns for about fifty hours and the vessel is worth keeping.

name: Linen Fig Candle
description: Green fig and cut grass. Lighter than the Ember, better for a bedroom.

name: Trio Votive Set
description: Three small scents in one box: fig, cedar, sea salt. The safe choice when you don't know what someone likes.

name: Stoneware Vase, Tall
description: Hand-thrown, so no two are identical. Holds long stems without tipping.

name: Stoneware Vase, Squat
description: The shorter sibling. Good for supermarket flowers, which is what people actually buy.

name: Bud Vase Cluster
description: Five small glass vases that group together. One stem each.

name: Alpaca Throw
description: Genuinely soft, genuinely warm, and light enough to actually use. The kind of thing nobody buys for themselves.

name: Waffle Cotton Throw
description: Washable, unfussy, gets softer with use. The everyday version of the alpaca.

name: Linen Cushion Pair
description: Two covers, inserts included. Stonewashed so they look lived-in from day one.

name: Reed Diffuser, Cedar
description: Three months of scent with no flame. Sensible for anyone with cats or small children.

name: Room Spray Duo
description: Great gift.

name: Nordic Wall Clock
description: Silent sweep movement, no ticking. Reads clearly from across a room.

name: Marble Bookends
description: Heavy enough to hold a shelf of hardbacks. Each pair has different veining.

name: Brass Picture Frame 13x18
description: Ages to a warm patina. Stands or hangs.

name: Woven Storage Basket
description: Holds blankets, firewood or the toys nobody puts away.

name: Entry Tray, Walnut
description: Keys, wallet, watch. Solves a small daily annoyance.

name: Ceramic Planter, Medium
description: Drainage hole and matching saucer, which most planters at this price skip.

name: Aurora Hanging Planter
description: Same glaze as the medium planter, on a cotton rope. Sold without the plant.

name: Herb Garden Kit
description: Basil, thyme and mint with soil discs and instructions that assume you know nothing.

name: Wool Door Mat
description: Coarse wool that actually takes mud off boots. Not for outdoors in the rain.

name: Terrazzo Coaster Set
description: Four coasters, cork-backed. Each one has a different chip pattern.

name: Amber Glass Tumbler Set
description: Six tumblers in smoked amber. Dishwasher safe, which the fancier ones never are.

name: Sheepskin Rug, Small
description: Draped over a chair rather than on the floor, mostly. Ethically sourced, certificate in the box.

name: Oak Serving Ladder
description: A leaning ladder for towels or throws. Ships flat, assembles in ten minutes.

name: Incense Set, Japanese
description: Three boxes, sandalwood to green tea, with a small ceramic holder.

name: Linen Table Runner
description: Two metres. Creases immediately and is supposed to.

name: Chef's Knife 20cm
description: A proper Japanese gyuto. Holds an edge, feels balanced, and will outlive whoever you give it to.

name: Paring Knife 9cm
description: The knife people actually reach for most. Pairs with the gyuto.

name: Knife Sharpening Stone
description: 1000/3000 grit combination stone with a non-slip base. Comes with a card explaining the angle.

name: Espresso Moka Pot 3-cup
description: The Italian classic in the size that fits two mugs. Induction-compatible base.

name: Pour-Over Set
description: Carafe, dripper, wooden collar and fifty filters. For the person who has opinions about water temperature.

name: Burr Coffee Grinder, Manual
description: Stepped adjustment from espresso to French press. Quiet, which the electric ones are not.

name: Cold Brew Carafe
description: One litre overnight in the fridge. Fine mesh, no grit.

name: Cocktail Kit, Ten-Piece
description: Shaker, jigger, strainer, muddler, spoon, tongs, three pourers and a stand. Recipe card for six classics.

name: Crystal Whisky Glasses, Pair
description: Heavy base, thin rim. Two, so they get used together.

name: Wine Preserver
description: Pumps the air out and keeps an open bottle drinkable for about a week.

name: Olive Wood Board, Large
description: Every board has a different grain. Big enough for a proper cheese course.

name: Slate Cheese Board Set
description: Slate board, four markers and three knives. You write the cheese names on the slate.

name: Enamel Casserole 24cm
description: Cast iron with an enamel coat, oven to table. Heavy, and that is the point.

name: Carbon Steel Pan 26cm
description: Pre-seasoned, gets better every time you use it. Not dishwasher safe and never will be.

name: Pasta Making Kit
description: Hand-crank roller, two cutters and a drying rack. A weekend project, not a weeknight one.

name: Bread Baking Set
description: Banneton, lame, scraper and a linen couche. Sourdough starter not included, deliberately.

name: Ceramic Dinner Set, Four
description: Sixteen pieces for four people. Chip-resistant and it stacks properly.

name: Handmade Pasta Bowls, Pair
description: Wide and shallow, the right shape for pasta and for everything else people put in bowls.

name: Copper Measuring Cups
description: Four nested cups. Decorative enough to hang up, accurate enough to use.

name: Salt & Pepper Mills, Pair
description: Ceramic grinding mechanism, adjustable from coarse to fine. Lifetime guarantee on the mechanism.

name: Tea Infuser Pot
description: Glass so you can watch the leaves open. Removable steel basket, 800ml.

name: Loose Leaf Tea Flight
description: Six tins, six origins, tasting notes on each. Enough of each for about ten cups.

name: Amber Glass Tumbler Set
description: Six tumblers in smoked amber. Dishwasher safe, which the fancier ones never are.

name: Herb Garden Kit
description: Basil, thyme and mint with soil discs and instructions that assume you know nothing.

name: Wireless Headphones ANC
description: Thirty hours with noise cancelling on. The case is slim enough for a laptop bag, which most cases are not.

name: Wireless Earbuds Pro
description: Four ear tip sizes in the box. Good ANC for the size, and they survive a run in the rain.

name: Open-Ear Sport Buds
description: They sit outside the ear canal so you still hear traffic. For running, not for flying.

name: Portable Speaker, Waterproof
description: IP67, floats, twelve hours. Loud enough for a kitchen or a small garden.

name: Turntable, Belt Drive
description: Built-in preamp so it plugs into anything. Comes with a decent cartridge already fitted.

name: E-Reader 7in Glare-Free
description: Warm and cool front light, waterproof, weeks of battery. The screen genuinely reads like paper.

name: E-Reader Case, Fabric
description: Magnetic, wakes and sleeps the device. Fits the 7in only.

name: Digital Photo Frame 10in
description: Relatives send photos to it from their phones. Set-up takes five minutes, which matters for the recipient.

name: Smart Plug, Pack of Four
description: Schedules and voice control. No hub needed, which is the whole reason to buy these.

name: Sunrise Alarm Clock
description: Brightens over thirty minutes before the alarm. Works properly in a room with blackout blinds.

name: Air Quality Monitor
description: CO2, particulates, humidity, temperature. Useful in a flat, revealing in an office.

name: Mechanical Keyboard, 65%
description: Hot-swap sockets so switches change without soldering. Ships with tactile browns.

name: Switch Sampler Pack
description: Nine switches to try before committing to ninety. A good add-on, a thin gift on its own.

name: Vertical Mouse, Wireless
description: Holds the wrist at fifty-seven degrees. Takes about a week to stop feeling strange.

name: Monitor Light Bar
description: Clips to the top of a screen and lights the desk, not the screen. No reflections.

name: Laptop Stand, Folding
description: Folds flat to the size of a paperback. Six height positions.

name: Power Bank 20000mAh
description: 100W out, so it charges a laptop, not just a phone. Airline-legal capacity.

name: Magnetic Wallet Stand
description: Three cards, folds into a stand. Weak magnets on cases thicker than 2mm.

name: Instant Camera
description: Prints in ninety seconds. Ten shots of film in the box, then it gets expensive.

name: Film Twin Pack
description: Twenty shots for the instant camera.

name: Drawing Tablet, Small
description: Battery-free pen, 8192 pressure levels. Works with the free software everyone actually uses.

name: Handheld Game Console, Retro
description: Plays cartridges and emulates the rest. Excellent d-pad, which is the whole thing.

name: Noise Machine
description: Real fan-based noise rather than a looped recording. No app, no lights, no subscription.

name: Smart Ring, Sleep Tracking
description: Sizing kit ships first, then the ring. Subscription required after the first year - worth saying out loud.

name: Bookshelf Speakers, Pair
description: Passive, so they need an amplifier the recipient may not own. The best-sounding thing in the catalogue and the easiest to get wrong as a gift.

name: Silk Pillowcase Pair
description: Two cases, machine washable on cold. Gentler on hair than cotton, which is the actual reason people love them.

name: Weighted Eye Mask
description: Warms in the microwave or chills in the freezer. Heavy enough to feel like something.

name: Skincare Discovery Set
description: Five travel sizes of the full range. The sensible way to gift skincare without guessing.

name: Vitamin C Serum 30ml
description: 15% L-ascorbic acid in an opaque pump. Six months once opened.

name: Hand Cream Trio
description: Three scents, handbag size. The default thank-you gift for a reason.

name: Beard Care Kit
description: Oil, balm, comb and scissors in a tin. Cedar and bergamot, not the usual sweet stuff.

name: Safety Razor Set
description: Razor, stand, brush and twenty blades. Cheaper than cartridges within four months.

name: Shaving Soap & Bowl
description: Sandalwood, lasts about six months of daily use. Refills sold separately.

name: Eau de Parfum, Fig & Cedar
description: Fifty millilitres, unisex, dries down warm. Risky as a gift unless you know the person's taste.

name: Fragrance Discovery Vials
description: Six 2ml vials with a voucher towards a full bottle. The answer to the risk above.

name: Massage Gun, Compact
description: Four heads, five speeds, quiet enough to use in front of the television.

name: Acupressure Mat Set
description: Mat and pillow with a carry bag. The first three minutes are unpleasant and then they are not.

name: Foam Roller, Textured
description: Firm density, textured surface. Not for beginners, who should get the smooth one.

name: Bath Soak Collection
description: Four jars: magnesium, rose, eucalyptus, seaweed. Wooden scoop in the box.

name: Turkish Bath Towel Set
description: Two bath, two hand. Thin, fast-drying, and they get softer for about a year.

name: Sauna Blanket
description: Infrared, folds into a cupboard. Big, expensive, and only right for someone who has mentioned wanting one.

name: Yoga Mat, Cork
description: Grip improves as your hands get damp, which is the opposite of foam mats.

name: Resistance Band Set
description: Five resistances, fabric not rubber, so they do not roll up on the thighs.

name: Fountain Pen, Medium Nib
description: Converter and two cartridges included. Writes wet, which suits most paper and not thin notebooks.

name: Rollerball Pen
description: Heavier than it looks. Takes standard refills, so it will never be orphaned.

name: Ink Sampler, Six Bottles
description: Six 10ml bottles, from a blue-black to an unreasonable orange.

name: Hardcover Notebook A5, Dotted
description: Lies flat, 100gsm so fountain pen does not bleed. 192 pages.

name: Notebook Trio A6
description: Three pocket notebooks that survive a back pocket for a month.

name: Leather Journal Cover A5
description: Refillable, so the same cover carries twenty notebooks. Can be blind-embossed with initials.

name: Desk Diary 2027
description: Week to view with a ribbon and a pocket. Dated, so it is a December gift or nothing.

name: Undated Weekly Planner
description: Fifty-two undated weeks, so it survives being started in March.

name: The Art of Slow Cooking
description: Ninety recipes that assume six hours and no supervision. Photography is unusually good.

name: Atlas of Remote Islands
description: Fifty islands the author has never visited, one map and one story each. Reliably delightful.

name: Boxed Classics, Set of Six
description: Cloth-bound, foil-stamped, in a slipcase. Bought for the shelf as much as the reading.

name: Poetry Anthology, Pocket
description: Two hundred short poems in a book that fits a coat pocket.

name: Calligraphy Starter Kit
description: Holder, five nibs, ink and a practice pad with guidelines. Instructions are clear.

name: Bookbinding Kit
description: Makes three sewn notebooks. A slow, satisfying afternoon.

name: Letterpress Card, Single
description: A card.

name: Letterpress Card Box, Ten
description: Ten blank cards with envelopes, cotton paper, properly pressed so the type has a dent in it.

name: Strategy Board Game, Trade Routes
description: Sixty to ninety minutes, two to four players. Teaches in ten minutes and stays interesting for fifty games.

name: Cooperative Game, Deep Water
description: Everyone against the board. Good for households where competition ends badly.

name: Two-Player Card Game
description: Twenty minutes, fits in a jacket. The one to pack for a holiday.

name: Party Game, Eighty Prompts
description: Loud, quick, needs at least four people and one extrovert.

name: Wooden Puzzle 500pc, Coastline
description: Laser-cut birch with whimsy pieces shaped like boats and birds. Genuinely hard.

name: Jigsaw 1000pc, Botanical
description: Matte finish so no glare under a lamp. Poster included for reference.

name: Jigsaw 1000pc, City Map
description: A lot of very similar grey pieces. For someone who finds the botanical one too easy.

name: Metal Puzzle Set, Six
description: Disentanglement puzzles, graded easy to infuriating. Solutions in a sealed envelope.

name: Chess Set, Weighted
description: Tournament-size board, weighted felted pieces. Folds to store the pieces inside.

name: Backgammon Roll-Up
description: Rolls into a tube with a strap. Pieces and dice live in a pocket.

name: Dominoes, Boxed
description: Double-nine set with a satisfying clack. The box is the good part.

name: Escape Room in a Box
description: Ninety minutes, one use only, and it is worth it. Do not peek in the envelopes.

name: Insulated Bottle 750ml
description: Twenty-four hours cold, twelve hot. The lid does not leak in a bag, which is not true of most.

name: Travel Mug, Leakproof
description: One-handed open, fits under a coffee machine, survives being dropped.

name: Vacuum Food Flask
description: Soup stays hot to lunchtime. Wide enough to eat from directly.

name: Weekender Bag
description: Fits two days including shoes. Waxed canvas, so rain beads off and it ages well.

name: Packing Cube Set
description: Four sizes, mesh tops. Converts chaotic packers into slightly less chaotic ones.

name: Daypack 20L, Roll-Top
description: Padded laptop sleeve, waterproof fabric, no branding. Commutes and hikes equally.

name: Picnic Blanket, Waterproof
description: Two metres square with a waterproof backing and a carry strap.

name: Camping Hammock
description: Straps included, packs to the size of a grapefruit, holds 150kg.

name: Head Torch, Rechargeable
description: 400 lumens, red night mode, USB-C. The red mode is the bit people end up using.

name: Enamel Camp Mug Pair
description: Two mugs that will chip and look better for it.

name: Gold Vermeil Chain Necklace
description: Forty-five centimetres, thick enough not to tangle. Vermeil, so it will not turn skin green.

name: Pearl Pendant
description: A single baroque pearl, so each one is a slightly different shape.

name: Huggie Earrings, Pair
description: Small enough to sleep in. Hinged clasp that does not come loose.

name: Stud Set, Three Pairs
description: Plain, pearl and stone. Covers most outfits and most moods.

name: Signet Ring, Engravable
description: Hand-engraved with up to three initials. Add a week for the engraving.

name: Stacking Rings, Set of Three
description: Sized as a set. Worn together or spread across fingers.

name: Leather Watch Strap 20mm
description: Quick-release pins, so it changes without tools. Check the lug width first.

name: Bracelet, Woven Cord
description: Adjustable slide, unisex, survives showers.

name: Wooden Building Blocks, 60pc
description: Sixty pieces in a cotton bag. Ages three and up, though adults build with them too.

name: Balance Board
description: Rocker, bridge, slide, den roof. The most-used toy in most houses that own one.

name: Illustrated Story Collection
description: Twelve stories, one per bedtime. Illustrated by hand, not generated.

name: Junior Science Kit
description: Twenty experiments with things you already have at home. Adult supervision for four of them.

name: Kids' Art Supply Case
description: Crayons, pencils, pastels and paper in a case that closes properly.

name: Night Light, Rechargeable
description: Silicone, warm and dimmable, safe to carry to the bathroom. Charges on a base.

name: Dog Bed, Orthopaedic
description: Removable washable cover, memory foam base. Large size fits a labrador.

name: Rope Toy Bundle
description: Four toys. Two will survive the month.

name: Cat Tree, Compact
description: Fits a corner rather than dominating a room. Sisal posts, two platforms.

name: Gift Card, 50 EUR
description: Digital, delivered by email, no expiry. The honest answer when you do not know the person.

name: Gift Card, 100 EUR
description: Digital, delivered by email, no expiry.
